_comment: Confirmed product bugs of the a11y area (prefix A11Y-nn), same schema as ../../known-bugs.json; the orchestrator merges them. support/a11y/known-bug.ts reads this file next to the shared registry, so the tests are marked before and after the merge. Evidence paths are relative to the repository root; the .output folders are produced by the tests themselves (stack 4: tests/e2e/.output/sf-e2e-4).

A11Y-01.title: Every splitter is role=separator with tabindex=0 but has no aria-valuenow: axe aria-required-attr (critical) on 4-5 nodes in every Regie state
A11Y-01.steps: Log in, open the Regie (any state), run axe-core (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa) on [role=separator]. Reproduced in 4 runs on stack 4.
A11Y-01.expected: A focusable separator is a widget (ARIA 1.2): it exposes aria-valuenow (and ideally aria-valuemin/-max) so a screen reader can announce its position; axe reports no critical violation.
A11Y-01.actual: Separators 'Height of the docks at the bottom', 'Size of Scenes and Sources', 'Size of Sources and Properties', 'Size of Properties and Stations' and (Studio Mode) 'Size of Preview and Program' have role=separator, tabindex=0, aria-label and aria-orientation but no aria-valuenow: 'Required ARIA attribute not present: aria-valuenow' (critical, 4 nodes direct mode, 5 in Studio Mode).
A11Y-01.fix: Set aria-valuenow (percentage or px of the split), aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax in SplitterDirective, or drop role=separator in favour of role=slider.

A11Y-02.title: The PGM tag in scene rows has a colour contrast of 4.32:1 (needs 4.5:1 for 10 px text)
A11Y-02.resolution: 2026-10-26: the dark red is lighter (--red #ff6a63, 5.05:1 for the tag text on the red wash over the current row; the light red is darker, #b71c28, 4.85:1 there). Guarded by tools/lib/studio-theme-contrast.spec.ts (the PGM / PVW tag test) and the dedicated axe test, which is a regression guard now.

A11Y-03.title: The “Space” hint on the Take button has a colour contrast of 3.78:1 (needs 4.5:1 for 11 px text)
A11Y-03.resolution: 2026-10-26: the hint no longer fades (opacity 0.85 removed): on-fill white on the Action Blue fill is 4.63:1 (3.78:1 before). Guarded by tools/lib/studio-theme-contrast.spec.ts and the dedicated axe test.

A11Y-04.title: The keys 1-9 and Space (Take) are ignored while the Studio Mode switch has the focus (a checkbox counts as a text field); Space on it toggles the mode back off
A11Y-04.steps: 1. Open the Regie with several scenes (Studio Mode off). 2. Toggle Studio Mode with the mouse (click) or with the keyboard (Tab to the switch, Space). The focus stays on the switch. 3. Press 4 (load scene 4 into the Preview) or Space (Take). Reproduced 3 times (keyboard) and once with the mouse.
A11Y-04.expected: The global shortcuts work whenever the focus is not in a text field: the Preview shows scene 4; Space on the switch only toggles it (acceptable), but digits are not typed text.
A11Y-04.actual: KeyboardService treats every INPUT as a typing target (TYPING_TAGS), so digits do nothing while the switch (input type=checkbox role=switch) has the focus; the Preview stays on the old scene without a message. After a mouse click on the switch a second Space (meant as Take) flips the mode off again.
A11Y-04.evidence: tests/e2e/.output/sf-e2e-4/artifacts (trace of the failing run with E2E_BUG_REPORT=1); apps/studio/src/app/core/ui/keyboard.service.ts (isTypingTarget)
A11Y-04.fix: isTypingTarget: only text-like input types (text, search, number, password, email, url, tel ...), not checkbox, radio, range, button; or blur the switch after toggling.

A11Y-05.title: At <= 1180 px the Preview/Program splitter stays visible and focusable (role=separator, tabindex=0) although it is disabled: a dead tab stop announced as resizable
A11Y-05.test: specs/a11y/a11y-responsive.spec.ts E2E-DEV-04 [regie-1180x800, no dead tab stop]
A11Y-05.steps: Open the Regie at 1180x800, Studio Mode on, press Tab through the page. Reproduced 2 times.
A11Y-05.expected: docs/testing.md DEV-04: grips and splitters are hidden (display:none) in the stacked layout (DEV-20: inert).
A11Y-05.actual: 'Size of Preview and Program' (20 x 295 px at x=484) is in the tab order with a focus indicator; Arrow keys do nothing (preview width stays 468 px). The dock splitters are display:none as specified; only .c-stage__split is not hidden below 1180 px (it is hidden at <= 900 px).
A11Y-05.evidence: tests/e2e/.output/sf-e2e-4/screens/regie-1180x800-studio.png (splitter between the monitors); apps/studio/src/app/stage/stage.component.scss (.c-stage__split has no display:none under the stacked mixin)
A11Y-05.fix: display: none for .c-stage__split in the stacked mixin, or tabindex -1 and aria-hidden while splitterDisabled().

A11Y-06.title: Accessible names of scene rows, source rows, station rows and incident targets do not contain their visible text (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name, axe label-content-name-mismatch, serious)
A11Y-06.steps: Open the Regie with seven scenes, five stations and an incident, run axe with the wcag21a tag. 10-15 nodes per state, reproduced in every Regie scan (12 states, 3 runs).
A11Y-06.expected: The accessible name contains the visible label text, so voice control (“Click Phone Entrance”) finds the control.
A11Y-06.actual: Incident target: visible “K3 Phone Entrance”, aria-label “Show K3 in Stations”. Scene row: visible “Break empty” with keycap, aria-label “Break”. Station row: visible “K3 Phone Entrance PVW reconnecting 00:03 freeze frame”, aria-label “K3 Phone Entrance, in Preview, reconnecting”. Source row: visible “K3 Phone Entrance reconnecting 00:03”, aria-label “Select: K3 Phone Entrance”. The key part of the label is in the name for the rows, but not for the incident target (the device name is missing).
A11Y-06.fix: Incident target: aria-label “Show K3 Phone Entrance in Stations” (contains the visible text); rows: keep the visible text first in the name, then add the state.

A11Y-07.title: Dark mode of the phone sender: the station code (2.96:1) and the hint “Tap for controls” (2.35:1) are below 4.5:1
A11Y-07.test: specs/a11y/a11y-axe.spec.ts E2E-DEV-15 [axe, contrast phone dark mode]
A11Y-07.steps: Pair a phone (Pixel 7 profile), camera live, press “Dark”, run axe color-contrast on .c-phone__dark. Reproduced 2 times.
A11Y-07.expected: Contrast >= 4.5:1, or a documented design exception (the mode is meant to emit almost no light on a stage).
A11Y-07.actual: .c-phone__dark-code 2.96:1, .c-phone__dark-hint 2.35:1. Both are aria-hidden, so only sighted users are affected; this is probably a deliberate trade-off between legibility and stage light and needs a decision.
A11Y-07.fix: Decide: raise the dim text to 4.5:1 or record the exception in DESIGN.md and accept the finding in the test.

A11Y-09.title: The Sources list of an empty scene is role=list without a listitem (the empty-state text is its only child): axe aria-required-children (critical)
A11Y-09.steps: Open the Regie, select (or switch to) a scene without elements (“Break”), run axe on the Sources dock. Reproduced in 4 scans (direct mode after a switch to “Break”, Studio Mode, station expanded, block confirmation).
A11Y-09.expected: A role=list contains listitems, or the empty state is rendered outside of the list.
A11Y-09.actual: contains This scene is empty. and the hint text only: 'Element has children which are not allowed: strong, text' (critical).
A11Y-09.fix: Render the list only when there are rows (@if rows().length) and the empty note next to it.

A11Y-10.title: prefers-reduced-motion has no effect on the CSS of the Regie: transitions (0.15 s) and the lamp pulse (1.2 s) still run; only the JS side (renderer fade, Program flash, scroll behaviour) honours it
A11Y-10.steps: Open the Regie with emulateMedia({reducedMotion: 'reduce'}); read getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--dur-state') and the transition-duration of any button (button.c-chipbtn, button.c-scene, ...); trigger a new outage (lamp pulse) or expand a station. Reproduced 4 times (first run: 80 elements with a transition-duration of 0.15 s at rest).
A11Y-10.expected: docs/testing.md DEV-16 / GAP-28: computed transition-duration and animation-duration are 0 s on UI elements, lamp pulse and flash animations are absent; _base.scss documents it: every duration token drops to 0 s with reduce.
A11Y-10.actual: --dur-state is .15s and --dur-lamp-pulse 1.2s under reduce. Cause: in styles.scss the base partial (with @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { :root { --dur-state: 0s ... } }) is emitted before the final :root block with the token values, which has the same specificity and wins; the universal '*, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0s; transition-duration: 0s }' has specificity 0 and loses to every component rule that sets a transition shorthand. The recorder sees css-transition and css-animation entries (lamp pulse, station flash/reveal) with reduce on.
A11Y-10.evidence: tests/e2e/.output/sf-e2e-4/artifacts (attachments motion-no-preference.json, motion-reduce.json, durations-at-rest.json of the failing run with E2E_BUG_REPORT=1); apps/studio/src/styles.scss, apps/studio/src/styles/_base.scss
A11Y-10.fix: Emit the reduced-motion token overrides after the token block (media query inside the :root block of styles.scss), and use !important in the universal rule or put it in an @layer that wins.

A11Y-11.title: No forced-colors support: in Windows high-contrast mode the Studio Mode switch is invisible and the selected Transition segment (Cut / Fade) cannot be told from the other
A11Y-11.steps: Open the Regie with emulateMedia({forcedColors: 'active'}) (Windows contrast themes), Studio Mode on, look at the control column; compare the computed style of the two Transition buttons. Reproduced 3 times.
A11Y-11.expected: docs/testing.md DEV-22: states remain distinguishable without colour. A switch needs a visible border; a selected segment a border, outline or weight.
A11Y-11.actual: The switch is an appearance:none input painted with background colours and a thumb pseudo-element; forced colours replaces the backgrounds with the canvas colour, so only the label “Studio Mode” is left (screenshot). The selected segment's underline is an inset box-shadow, which forced colours removes; border, outline, decoration and weight are identical for both segments, only an 8 % background tint is left. The CSS contains no @media (forced-colors: active) rule.
A11Y-11.fix: @media (forced-colors: active): border: 1px solid ButtonText on the switch input and the thumb in CanvasText; for the segments a border-bottom or outline on [aria-pressed=true].

A11Y-12.title: At 390 px an incident of a station with a long device name makes the message strip wider than the viewport: horizontal page scroll (the name in button.c-status__target is neither wrapped nor cut)
A11Y-12.test: specs/a11y/a11y-extra.spec.ts E2E-DEV-18 [long text, 390x844, incident of a station with a 60-character name]
A11Y-12.steps: Open the Regie at 390x844 with a station that has an open incident (K3 reconnecting) and whose device name has 60 characters (PATCH /devices/{id} name of 60 characters, allowed), direct mode. Reproduced 2 times (once with the device name 'Phone with a very long name for the station list and the mes...').
A11Y-12.expected: docs/testing.md DEV-18: ellipsis or wrap inside rows, strip entries and station rows; no horizontal scroll.
A11Y-12.actual: document scrollWidth 431 > clientWidth 390: div.c-status__inc.is-warn spans x 16..431, button.c-status__target x 20..421. The same long name in the Stations dock, the monitors and the scene rows stays inside (tested at 1280, 900 and 390 px).
A11Y-12.evidence: tests/e2e/.output/sf-e2e-4/screens/regie-long-text-390x844-long-incident-direct.png (the strip entry reaches beyond the right edge); assertion message of the run with E2E_BUG_REPORT=1
A11Y-12.fix: min-width: 0 and text-overflow: ellipsis (or wrapping) on .c-status__target and its name text; the strip entry is a flex container.

A11Y-13.title: The seams next to the outer docks move 20.3 px or 11.6 px per arrow key instead of 16 px (Shift: 66.8 / 58.7 instead of 64); the middle seam is exact (same finding as REGIE-02)
A11Y-13.steps: Open the Regie at 1440x900, Tab to the separator “Size of Scenes and Sources” (or “Size of Properties and Stations”) and press ArrowRight, Shift+ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Shift+ArrowLeft; measure the x position of the separator. Reproduced 3 times.
A11Y-13.expected: docs/testing.md DEV-14 / DESIGN.md: arrows move a separator 16 px, Shift 64 px.
A11Y-13.actual: Scenes|Sources: ArrowRight +20.3, +20.0, Shift +66.8, ArrowLeft -13.0, Shift -59.9, -11.7; Properties|Stations: +11.6, +11.5, Shift +58.7, -21.0, -68.1, -19.9; Sources|Properties (middle): +16.0, +16.0, +63.8, -16.1, -64.0, -15.9.
A11Y-13.evidence: assertion message of the run with E2E_BUG_REPORT=1; tests/e2e/specs/regie/bugs.json REGIE-02 (same finding)
A11Y-13.fix: Compute the weight change from the width of the two docks without the window gutter (or convert the pixel step with the real content widths).

A11Y-08.title: Presence text: “2 people in the control room” (numeral) where docs/testing.md DEV-15 pins “Two people in the control room”; one person is spelled out (“One person”)
A11Y-08.steps: Open the Regie in two browser contexts with the same session.
A11Y-08.expected: “Two people in the control room” (docs/testing.md DEV-15).
A11Y-08.actual: “2 people in the control room” (header.component.ts presenceText); the visible label and the screen-reader text both use the numeral for >= 2.
A11Y-08.fix: Either spell out small numbers in presenceText or change the plan to the numeral (documentation difference).
